device: RTX 5090 at the reference 28 Gb/s GDDR7 data rate
workload: Copy a cold, incompressible 256 MiB device buffer to a distinct destination on one GPU
assumptions: The complete source starts in external memory and the destination must be committed there by the timing boundary.
The permitted copy uses distinct, uncompressed storage and the reference memory clock.

resources.name: external GDDR7
resources.minimum_work_basis: One complete 256 MiB off-chip read and one complete 256 MiB off-chip write.
resources.upper_rate_basis: NVIDIA reference 28 Gb/s per pin and 512-bit memory interface, 1.792 TB/s rated peak. https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/graphics-cards/50-series/rtx-5090/
